name: Hell Flame Incarnate
status: Integrated: shipped lineage, seven combat forms, transformation, transcendence and Hell Step/Travel.
west: Native east mirroring; no west texture required.

sequences.name: HellscarCrescent
sequences.note: Right-facing convex edge; move along +X and rotate to aim.

sequences.name: AshenPursuit
sequences.note: Right-facing narrow route wake; reuse at reduced size for ordinary movement.

sequences.name: InfernalWaltz
sequences.note: Clockwise spin loop; use C# scale/fade envelope at start/end.

sequences.name: RuinousPhoenix
sequences.note: Descending phoenix; damage belongs to saved action state.

sequences.name: HellfireReversal
sequences.note: Retreat-origin flash; combine with route wake and native pawn afterimages.

sequences.name: FurnaceDominion
sequences.note: Expanding ground ring; knockback and one impact are code driven. Frame 00 is the transparent ignition lead-in.

sequences.name: SovereignSeal
sequences.note: Fixed ground warning seal; can also introduce travel or the ceremony.

sequences.name: SovereignColumn
sequences.note: Tall ultimate layer; ground anchor near bottom of cell.

sequences.name: SovereignBurst
sequences.note: Ultimate impact and fading outward flame fragments.

sequences.name: HellStepFlash
sequences.note: Small local blink departure/arrival flash; never an extra damage hit.

sequences.name: EmberMotes
sequences.note: Place at small size; reuse as short fading ember fragments.

sequences.name: TranscendCharge
sequences.note: Gathering flame/crown charge, reusable in the eight-second ceremony.

sequences.name: Halo
sequences.note: Shallow hollow infernal crown; only transformed, drafted and standing.

sequences.name: BackAura
sequences.note: Subtle paired ember mantle behind body; suggested opacity 0.35.

sequences.name: Hellbrand
sequences.note: Caster-owned mark glint; share art through positioning.

runtimeConstraints: Use existing bounded 192-effect / 64-afterimage pools, cached materials, camera/fog culling and bounded local target searches.
C# owns movement, impact commitment, knockback, status, damage and interrupted-action cleanup. Animation playback never triggers damage.
Keep black flame bodies on alpha-capable materials; additive-only drawing loses black silhouettes.
Halo/back aura visibility: transformed, drafted and standing. Personal clothing restores through shared gear handling.
Use native pawn renderer snapshots for afterimages; do not generate separate victim or body ghost textures.
Reuse shared corrected Thunder Step/Travel state cycle and safe landing/cancellation/save handling when implementing utility.
artRevision: v2 — tailored black suit/cape and Ashreign katana
armorStyle: Fitted black tailored suit and waistcoat, low collar, close-hanging black cape, crimson inner lining and restrained molten-orange flame trim. No plate armor or helmet.
swordStyle: Right-curving ivory katana, orange ember etching, black/crimson wrapped handle, compact black/orange tsuba.

katanaIntegration.status: Use Thunder Incarnate held-edge correction for the future Hell Flame weapon and verify both held/AM animation renderers at integration.
